snippet.title: Edge of Memories | Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a deep dive into the gameplay of Edge of Memories!

In Avaris, beauty and decay go hand in hand as the Corrosion spreads. See for the first time how you will fight it: through fast-paced combat, tactical skill sets, progression and exploration across the vast continent of Avaris.

Did you see our trailer during Nacon Connect? This is the extended 4-minute version with even more detail on the combat and exploration systems. If you're interested in the game, you won't want to miss this!

Edge of Memories is set to release later in 2026.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738170/Edge_of_Memories/
